content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NII Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 19-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NII Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NII Senior Project Associate position is 19th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc degree in any branch of Life Sciences with at least four years of R&D experience, or a PhD in any branch of Life Sciences to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate position is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Project Associate position will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month, plus 27% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NII Senior Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the NII Senior Project Associate recruitment must be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NII Senior Project Associate recruitment will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NII Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 100/-, while SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Project Associate in the National Institute of Immunology (NII) through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Senior Project Associate position at NII is a contract-based job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the PDF thoroughly before applying.
